record.original_question: Are strongly pseudoconvex CR manifolds of real dimension 5 locally embeddable?

evidence.quote: Problem 12.1.1 Are strongly pseudoconvex CR surfaces of real dimension 5 locally embeddable? 12.2 Extensions

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth abstract CR manifold of real dimension $5$ that is strongly pseudoconvex. Recall that an abstract CR structure on $M$ consists of a smooth complex subbundle $T^{1,0}M \subset \mathbb{C}\otimes TM$ of complex rank $2$ such that $T^{1,0}M \cap \overline{T^{1,0}M} = 0$ and $[T^{1,0}M, T^{1,0}M] \subset T^{1,0}M$ (integrability). Strong pseudoconvexity means that the Levi form, defined for a local real one-form $\theta$ annihilating $T^{1,0}M \oplus \overline{T^{1,0}M}$ by $L_\theta(X,\overline{Y}) = -i\,d\theta(X,\overline{Y})$ for $X,Y \in T^{1,0}M$, is positive definite (after a choice of sign of $\theta$).

Question: Is every such $M$ locally CR-embeddable? Equivalently, for every point $p \in M$, does there exist an open neighborhood $U \ni p$ and a smooth CR map $F: U \to \mathbb{C}^N$ (for some $N$), i.e. a map whose components are annihilated by every section of $\overline{T^{1,0}M}$, such that $F$ is an embedding of $U$ onto a CR submanifold of $\mathbb{C}^N$?
artifact.status_search_result: Multiple recent sources (including a 2025 arXiv preprint and surveys in CR geometry) state that local embeddability of strongly pseudoconvex abstract CR manifolds is known in real dimension $\geq 9$ (Kuranishi) and dimension $7$ (Akahori), fails in dimension $3$ (Nirenberg and others), and that the dimension-$5$ case remains an open, notably delicate problem.

status_evidence.title: CR Paneitz operator and embeddability
status_evidence.snippet: The problem of local embedding remains open in real dimension 5. In real dimension 9 and higher, local embedding ... is true by the work of Kuranishi and in real dimension 7 by the work of Akahori.
status_evidence.claim: The local embeddability problem for strongly pseudoconvex CR manifolds in real dimension 5 is open.

status_evidence.title: Geometry and Analysis on Cauchy Riemann Manifolds (BIRS report)
status_evidence.snippet: Whether local embeddability holds for 5-dimensional strongly pseudoconvex CR manifolds is remarkably delicate.
status_evidence.claim: Dimension 5 local embeddability is identified as a delicate, unresolved problem.
